basis: “It” could refer to the returned filesystem or the configured directory. Naming MigrationDirectoryFS clarifies which API the host should check before treating the URL as an ordinary directory.
replacement:
`projectconfig.Config.MigrationDirectoryFS` returns the immutable
filesystem behind a resolved `data.template_dir` URL; a host that consumes the
configured migration directory should check `MigrationDirectoryFS` before opening the URL as an
ordinary directory.
